title: Orbit installer fails with ORB-1042 missing prerequisite
body:
Share | Edit | Flag

Running ./install.sh stops with:

ORB-1042: required prerequisite not found: JDK 17+

JDK 11 is installed. Prerequisites:

ComponentVersion
JDK17+
Disk20 GB
Asked 3 months ago
author: asker

answers.body:
ORB-1042 means no JDK 17 or newer was found. Install JDK 17 and point the installer at it.

Linux:

```bash
export JAVA_HOME=/opt/jdk-17
./install.sh --prefix /opt/orbit
```

Windows (PowerShell):

```powershell
$env:JAVA_HOME = 'C:\jdk-17'
.\install.ps1 -Prefix C:\orbit
```
answers.author: dana
